409.description: A step or state change on an ended run (`run_ended`).

202.description: The request waits for the member.

422.description: `pair_target_unavailable`, `agent_already_paired`, `pair_request_unavailable` (a request is already waiting), or the body failed validation.

client_run_id.description: The agent's own id for this run; a retry with the same id returns the same run.

task.description: Task key (EO-21) or id; when omitted the server looks for a key in `branch`, then in the `worktree` folder name.

agent_kind.description: The coding tool driving the run (`claude_code`, `cursor`, `codex`, `cline`, `roo`, `opencode`, `aider`), shown in place of the connection's kind; any other value is ignored.

task.description: Task key or id; null unfiles the run. Members may send only this.

ended_at.description: When the work ended, if earlier than this request; read only when `state` ends the run, and kept between the run's last activity and now.

ack.description: Message ids already shown; ids of other runs are ignored.

events.description:
At most 100. Fields depend on `type`: step {phase, label, plan_key, restored}, commit {sha, repo, subject},
test_run {command, label, result_line, exit_code}, review_finding {severity, summary, outcome},
ruling {what, why, cost_if_wrong}, pull_request {action, url, repo, number},
usage {model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, wall_ms}, plan {source, path, items: [{key, text}], at most 200, restored},
waiting {kind: permission|question|idle}, resumed {}, turn {phase: started|ended}. Overlong text is truncated, secrets redacted, other keys dropped.

id.description: The agent's own id for this event; a replay is counted as a duplicate.

task_key.description: The task this event belongs to, when not the run's; an unknown key files it under no task.

ack.description: Message ids already shown; ids of other runs are ignored.

client_ref.description: The client's own key for what it imports, such as the repo remote and change id; a retry by the same member returns the same task.

space.description: Space id or key (any case); one the member can see. `spaces` in the conventions lists them.

description.description: Markdown, cut to 10000 characters, secrets redacted.

plan.description: The plan file as a `plan` event carries it ({source, path, items}), with a path; `todo` plans have no file and are refused. Becomes the checklist when the workspace imports plans, unless the task is an epic awaiting its PR subtasks.

AuthorizationException.description: An authorization gate on this route refused the request. Which gates run varies by route: one resolving a tenant refuses a tenant that is not active; one additionally requiring membership refuses a caller holding no grant in it; a control-plane route refuses a caller holding no operator grant for this region; a saved-views route refuses a caller with no authorized scope for the request host — no grant in the tenant it resolves to, or no control-plane grant where it resolves to none; a route requiring a permission refuses a caller whose roles do not include it; a workspace requiring two-factor authentication refuses a member with no confirmed factor once their grace period has ended, with `code` `two_factor_required` and a `setup_url`; and every one of them refuses an impersonation session reaching a tenant other than the one it was authorized for. An operation carrying none of those gates is still refused by the pin: an impersonation session that resolves no tenant may reach the impersonated member's own self-service surface and nothing else; and a route closed to impersonation refuses every impersonation session. A route accepting API keys refuses a key request with `module_disabled` while the workspace has API keys turned off.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
